script_text: Stop, Pisces—your romantic fantasy is about to collide head-on with a very practical Saturn lesson today. Neptune, the traditional ruler of your water sign Pisces, sits near 1° Aries in the 6th House, sextiling the Sun in your 1st almost exactly. Pluto in your 10th House raises the stakes at your next performance review; control the narrative with evidence, not emotion. In love, Venus in your 12th House can draw someone thoughtful and private if you are single, but keep your standards higher than a late-night message. If attached, separate affection from follow-through before you build a shared future. Career-wise, turn the 6th-to-1st-house flow into professional expertise, because the 10th House rewards visible, disciplined delivery. In the 2nd House, request a deposit before extra revisions; do not undercharge for unlimited work. Avoid promises without deadlines. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
